description: This file defines a class 'CatalogTestGrain' which extends 'Grain' and implements 'ICatalogTestGrain'. It includes asynchronous methods for activation, initialization, and performing a blast call to multiple grains, primarily used for testing or benchmarking purposes within an Orleans distributed system project.

classes.name: CatalogTestGrain
classes.description: A grain class used for testing, capable of initializing and calling other grains.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation method to include a delay upon activation.

methods.name: BlastCallNewGrains
methods.description: Calls the Initialize method on multiple grains concurrently.
